propositions: Configuration must resolve once per operation boundary with immutable, serializable OperationSnapshot following precedence: explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default, preventing mid-operation rereading.

Authentication composition across LLM, Git, bridge, MCP, review-bot, and op-cert must be consistent and enforced through subsystem-local runtime bindings without arbitrary client/runner injection or multiple scheduler paths.

Op-cert must accept exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY, validate before queue/worker/network creation, and use a process-owned 0700/0600 copy with context-local signer bindings.

Static credentials must be represented only as provider-specific Pydantic SecretStr/SecretBytes carriers and revealed only in sending adapters, never persisted in logs, serialization, exceptions, argv, or subprocess environments.

Same-capability children inherit ambient environment; owning children receive only their adapter overlay; unrelated siblings lose exact secret names declared by other Rebar adapters, with deployment/container boundaries as primary isolation.

Portable AST ownership gate must derive config/credential names from authoritative registries, reject reads/reloads/defaults below approved seams, permit only exact path/symbol+rationale exceptions, and reach zero legacy exceptions at cutover.
